title: Adult physical activity recommendations
source: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
text: For adults, the CDC recommends at least 150 minutes of moderate-intensity aerobic activity each week, or 75 minutes of vigorous-intensity activity, or an equivalent combination. Adults should also do muscle-strengthening activities on at least 2 days a week. Some activity is better than none, and activity can be spread through the week. These are general population guidelines and do not assess an individual's health or determine what is safe for a specific person.
